format_note: sells_to is written as MEMBERSHIP TYPES (who the person is) and SITUATIONS (what just happened to them), never as an activity the product enables. Each `types` line names the CATEGORY first ('ANY trade', 'ANY small business') and gives examples after 'e.g.' — examples are illustrative, never a closed list. An activity the product helps with (making video, buying insurance, marketing) is never a condition of membership.

clients.name: Solo Agency
clients.sells: an AI-run sales & marketing team (lead finding, CRM, outreach, content) for businesses run by one person or a very small team
clients.sells_to: anyone who runs a business alone or nearly alone and has to find their own customers, in any industry, anywhere. They buy for their own business.
types: independent professional of ANY trade who lives on their own pipeline (e.g. real-estate agent, loan officer, insurance agent, escrow officer, advisor, lawyer, dentist, consultant, coach)
owner of ANY small local shop or service business (e.g. salon, restaurant, auto shop, clinic, tutoring center, photo studio, gym, property management)
founder of a tiny startup or SaaS with no sales/marketing staff

creator, course seller or freelancer of ANY kind who sells something to clients (a freelancer selling services to others is a customer here, not a competitor, unless they sell marketing or lead generation itself)
clients.why_they_need: they have no marketing or sales staff, no time to post or prospect consistently, and their income depends on a steady flow of leads
clients.competitors: marketing agencies, lead-generation services, AI marketing or CRM tools that sell to the same solo businesses, coaches who sell marketing programs to them
clients.not_buyers: employees of large companies who do not own a pipeline, job seekers, students, consumers looking for a service for themselves

clients.name: AI video-edit SaaS (founder-led startup)
clients.sells: an app that turns raw phone footage into edited short videos automatically (cuts, captions, music), sold as a monthly subscription
clients.sells_to: people who sell something and could grow by posting more video, whether or not they make any video today. Membership is by who they are, never by whether they already film.
types: independent professional of ANY trade who markets themselves (e.g. real-estate agent, loan officer, insurance agent, escrow officer, lawyer, dentist, advisor, coach, consultant, photographer, videographer)
owner of ANY small shop or service business (e.g. salon, restaurant, gym, clinic, auto shop, food truck, tutoring center, property management)
founder of a small startup or SaaS
creator, course seller, freelancer or one-person agency of ANY kind (a marketing or lead-gen agency, a coach, a graphic designer are customers here; they need video too)
clients.why_they_need: editing is the step that stops them from posting consistently: it takes hours or costs money per video; they lack time, skill or an editor
clients.competitors: other video-editing apps or AI editing tools, freelance video editors, video production agencies that sell editing to the same people
clients.not_buyers: large media teams with in-house editors, job-seeking editors, students, people who sell nothing

clients.name: Realtor (Orange County, California)
clients.sells: help buying, selling or leasing homes in and around Orange County, California
clients.sells_to: people whose housing is about to change in or into Orange County (B2C).
types: person about to buy, sell, rent out or lease a home in Orange County, or arriving into Orange County (a stated move there, a job there)
homeowner in Orange County weighing a move or asking what their home is worth
investor looking at property in Orange County
clients.why_they_need: a transaction or a move is coming and they need a local agent they trust
clients.location: Orange County, CA and neighbouring areas; a person rooted elsewhere with no plan involving this area is low fit; a homeowner staying put (renovating, refinancing) is not a housing change
clients.competitors: other real-estate agents and brokers serving the same area
clients.not_buyers: agents elsewhere (not competitors, not buyers), lenders, escrow, inspectors and other transaction partners (they refer buyers but do not buy), renters of a single room, people with no housing change in sight

clients.name: Insurance agent (auto, home, life, small-business; California)
clients.sells: insurance policies and coverage reviews: auto, home and renters, life, and coverage for small businesses
clients.sells_to: two segments in California: (1) a person whose life just changed in a way that creates something to protect or a cost to review; (2) any self-employed professional or small-business owner, in any trade, for business coverage (liability, errors & omissions, workers' comp, commercial auto).
types: person in California with a new asset, a new dependent, a new address, a new job or a switch to self-employment, a rising or expiring policy, or a risk they just became aware of
self-employed professional of ANY trade in California (e.g. real-estate agent, loan officer, escrow officer, lawyer, consultant, coach, contractor, photographer, freelancer)
owner of ANY small business in California (e.g. salon, restaurant, shop, clinic, auto shop, food truck, software startup)
clients.why_they_need: every change in what they own, who depends on them, or what they run changes what they must insure, and prices move every year; every business must carry coverage
clients.location: California; a person clearly outside California is low fit unless moving in
clients.competitors: other insurance agents and brokers, insurers selling direct, comparison sites
clients.not_buyers: insurance-industry job seekers, adjusters and claims staff acting for insurers, people outside the licensed area with no move planned

clients.name: Mortgage loan officer (California)
clients.sells: home purchase loans, pre-approvals and refinancing in California
clients.sells_to: two segments: (1) people in California who will need a home loan or could restructure one; (2) real-estate agents and brokers, named here as a partner segment that counts as leads.
types: person planning to buy a home in California (first-time buyer, mover, investor)

homeowner in California holding a mortgage (a refinance candidate whenever rates or life change; a recent purchase still counts because they hold a loan; a refinance completed and locked with relief is settled)
real-estate agent or broker who hands buyers to a lender (partner segment; counts as a lead; their listings and closings are routine work, not intent)
clients.why_they_need: a purchase needs financing and approval before the offer; a rate move or life change makes an existing loan worth restructuring; agents need a lender who closes on time
clients.location: California; buyers elsewhere are low fit unless buying in California
clients.competitors: other loan officers, mortgage brokers, banks and lenders marketing loans to the same people
clients.not_buyers: people seeking a job as a loan officer, renters with no purchase plan, homeowners with no mortgage and no plan to move
